headline: Three o'clock keeps the lamp.
body: The street has emptied down to a bus that will not come. Paper on the desk has cooled; the last sentence still wet an hour ago is now a dull crease. Somewhere a lift door opens and no one steps out.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: slate, a faint east that is not dawn

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: wet kerb, one taxi idling with no fare

pulses.label: Mood
pulses.value: the room holding its breath between pages
